result:
If I could change only one thing, I'd make humans dramatically better at seeking truth and updating their beliefs when they're wrong.

Most of the world's biggest problems aren't primarily a lack of resources, intelligence, or good intentions. They're the result of motivated reasoning, tribal loyalty overriding evidence, short-term thinking, and the human talent for convincing ourselves of things that feel good rather than things that are true. Fix the underlying epistemology and a huge amount of downstream stupidity, conflict, and wasted effort would shrink on its own.

Everything else — poverty, disease, coordination problems, even existential risks — becomes more solvable when the people working on them are less likely to lie to themselves or each other. 

Of course, this is probably one of the hardest things to actually change.
